head.t: bioMérieux holds £1.29m bridging contract for Dorset's microbiology pathology service
head.x: University Hospitals Dorset NHS Foundation Trust has directly awarded bioMérieux a two-year, £1,285,884 contract to continue its Pathology Managed Service for Microbiology while the Southern Counties Pathology network implements the new Molecular Diagnostics Lot 5.

f.t: bioMérieux holds £1.29m bridging contract for Dorset's microbiology pathology service
f.x: University Hospitals Dorset NHS Foundation Trust has directly awarded bioMérieux a two-year, £1,285,884 contract to continue its Pathology Managed Service for Microbiology while the Southern Counties Pathology network implements the new Molecular Diagnostics Lot 5.

f.t: Contract awarded: Automated AST & Bacteria Testing
f.x: Buyer: The Common Services Agency(more commonly known as NHS National Services Scotland) (NSS).

f.t: Framework: NHS Supply Chain — Laboratory Diagnostics, POCT & Pathology (to 2028)
Framework ending 11 March 2028: Laboratory Diagnostics, Point of Care Testing and Pathology Managed Services
f.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "bioMerieux UK Ltd" (Lot 1, Lot 2, Lot 8). 122 suppliers on the framework.
